parameters.help_en:
The current billing method of the instance. Valid values:
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: subscription.
Serverless (not supported for ApsaraDB RDS for MariaDB instances): serverless.

To change the billing method to serverless, you must configure the auto-start and auto-stop (AutoPause), scaling range (MaxCapacity and MinCapacity), and elastic policy (SwitchForce) in subsequent parameters. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/411291.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/604344.html, and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607742.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例当前的付费类型，取值：
Postpaid：后付费（按量付费）。
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）。
Serverless（不支持MariaDB实例）：Serverless付费类型。

如需变更为Serverless类型，必须在后续参数中配置自动启停（AutoPause）、扩缩容范围（MaxCapacity、MinCapacity）和弹性策略（SwitchForce）。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/411291.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/604344.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607742.html
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The effective time of the new configurations. Valid values:
Changing some configurations may affect the instance. Read the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96061.html carefully before you configure this parameter. We recommend that you do this during off-peak hours.
Immediate (default): takes effect immediately.
MaintainTime: takes effect within the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610402.html.
ScheduleTime: takes effect at a specified time. The specified time must be at least 12 hours later than the current time, and the actual switchover time follows the formula: EffectiveTime = ScheduleTime + SwitchTime
parameters.help_zh:
新配置生效时间，取值：
变更部分配置可能对实例产生影响，请仔细阅读https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96061.html，再配置该参数，建议在业务低峰期进行。
Immediate（默认值）：立即生效。
MaintainTime：在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610402.html生效。
ScheduleTime：指定时间切换。该时间需为当前时间12小时之后的一个时刻，且实际切换时间遵循EffectiveTime=ScheduleTime+SwitchTime
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en:
The instance storage type. Valid values:
local_ssd: premium local SSD
cloud_ssd: standard SSD (not recommended. Sales have stopped in some regions)
cloud_essd: PL1 ESSD
cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD
cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD
general_essd: Premium ESSD

If you want to change the instance storage type, take note of the following items:
<props="china">* If you change the instance storage type from ESSD to Premium ESSD, other parameters such as the instance type and storage capacity must remain the same as the original values and cannot be modified.</props>

<props="china">* For ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL or MariaDB instances whose instance storage type is standard SSD, you can set this parameter to `cloud_essd` to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/314678.html. To perform the upgrade, you must specify both DBInstanceClass and DBInstanceStorage, and their values must be the same as the current values of the instance.</props>

<props="china">* For ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances, you can upgrade standard SSDs to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96750.html, but you cannot downgrade ESSDs to standard SSDs.</props>

<props="intl">For ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances, you can upgrade standard SSDs to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96750.html, but you cannot downgrade ESSDs to standard SSDs.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例存储类型，取值：
local_ssd：高性能本地盘
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘（不推荐，部分地域已经停止售卖）
cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘
general_essd：高性能云盘

如需变更存储类型，请注意：
<props="china">* 如果将实例存储类型由ESSD变更为高性能云盘，则其他参数（实例规格、存储空间大小等）需与实例原参数值保持一致，不允许修改。</props>

<props="china">* 对于MySQL或MariaDB实例，存储类型为SSD云盘时，您可以传入`cloud_essd`将实例的存储类型https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/314678.html。如需升级，则**DBInstanceClass**和**DBInstanceStorage**都需要传入，且需要与实例现有的值相同。</props>

<props="china">* 对于PostgreSQL实例可以将SSD云盘升级为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96750.html，但**不支持将ESSD云盘降级为SSD云盘**。</props>

<props="intl">对于PostgreSQL实例可以将SSD云盘升级为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96750.html，但**不支持将ESSD云盘降级为SSD云盘**。</props>

parameters.help_en: The time when the specification change is performed. We recommend that you perform the specification change during off-peak hours. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC time). The specified time must be later than the current time (the time when the call is initiated). Otherwise, the specification change task will fail. After the task fails, you must wait for the order to be automatically canceled before you can initiate the call again. If you only increase the storage capacity or change the ESSD storage type, the specification change is performed immediately after submission because it does not affect your business. You do not need to configure this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 指定执行变配的时间，建议在业务低峰期执行变配。 格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 指定的变配时间必须晚于当前时间（即发起调用的时间），否则变配任务将失败。任务失败后，您需要等待订单自动作废后才能重新发起调用。 如果仅增加存储空间或进行ESSD存储类型的变更，由于对业务无影响，变配操作将在提交后立即执行，无需配置此参数

Specifies whether to enable the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2838448.html feature for the serverless ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL or PostgreSQL instance. Valid values:
true: enables the feature.
false (default): disables the feature.

If no connections are established within 10 minutes, the instance enters the paused state. When a connection is established, the instance is automatically woken up

fields.help_en:
The maximum number of ApsaraDB RDS capacity units (RCUs) for the automatic scaling of the serverless instance. Valid values:
MySQL: 1 to 32
SQL Server: 2 to 16 (integers only)
PostgreSQL: 1 to 14

The value must be greater than or equal to the value of MinCapacity
fields.help_zh:
Serverless实例RCU的自动扩缩范围最大值，取值：
MySQL：1~32
SQL Server：2~16（仅支持整数）
PostgreSQL：1~14

该值必须大于等于MinCapacity
fields.name: max_capacity

fields.help_en:
The minimum number of RCUs for the automatic scaling of the serverless instance. Valid values:

MySQL: 0.5 to 32
SQL Server: 2 to 16 (integers only)
PostgreSQL: 0.5 to 14

The value must be less than or equal to the value of MaxCapacity
fields.help_zh:
Serverless实例RCU的自动扩缩范围最小值，取值：

MySQL：0.5~32
SQL Server：2~16（仅支持整数）
PostgreSQL：0.5~14

该值必须小于等于MaxCapacity
fields.name: min_capacity

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable forced elastic scaling for the serverless ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL or PostgreSQL instance. Elastic scaling of RCUs usually takes effect immediately. However, in some special cases (such as during the execution of large transactions), the scaling cannot be completed immediately. In this case, you can enable this parameter to force the scaling. Valid values:

true: enables forced elastic scaling.
false (default): disables forced elastic scaling.

After this parameter is enabled, the instance will be unavailable for 30 to 120 seconds during forced scaling. Use this parameter with caution based on your actual situation
fields.help_zh:
MySQL Serverless或PostgreSQL Serverless实例的强制弹性扩缩容。实例RCU的弹性扩缩容通常会立刻生效，但在某些特殊情况下（例如大事务执行中）无法即刻完成扩缩容，此时可开启本参数进行强制扩缩容。取值：

true：启用
false（默认值）：不启用

开启该参数后，实例进行强制扩缩容时会出现30~120秒的服务不可用，请根据实际情况谨慎使用

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitch ID. The zone where the vSwitch resides must correspond to the zone ID specified in ZoneId.

The network type (InstanceNetworkType) must be VPC.
If you specify ZoneSlaveId1 (the secondary zone ID), you must specify two vSwitch IDs and separate them with a comma (,).
You only need to specify the vSwitch when you upgrade the major engine version of an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance (AllowMajorVersionUpgrade) or when you switch the vSwitch
parameters.help_zh:

网络类型InstanceNetworkType需为VPC。
若您填写了ZoneSlaveId1（备可用区ID），此处需填写两个交换机ID，并使用半角逗号（,）隔开。
